details: Hello, I'm on metta quest 3s and 2 days ago (8/17/2026) my YouTube search suddenly stopped working in a world called "loft nine by vera", I was with a friend who just got vrc on their PC and are still learning, as far as i can tell PC users are not having this bug. Me and my friend left that world thinking it was world spesific. We went to "Popcorn palace" and i attempted the YouTube search there, i could see videos to choose from in both world but on selecting one it did not load fully. Note I got no error messages in any worlds. I tried switching media players, clearing all my catch's, checking my headset for updates, checking vrc for updates, turning "unknown urls" off and on again, turning "unknown urls" off > quitting the game and re opening it > and turning it back on, network switching, restarting my headset, and none of that worked. I did the majority of that today (day of posting). Yesterday i tried just doing a YouTube link, I first tried it in "Amethyst Cozy Nights" and it didn't work, i then tried it in the video player in "Prisimic's avatar search." I will note in testing out things trying to fix it myself, YouTube short videos worked in the "Popcorn palace" world YouTube search. I haven't tried mp4 links because i don't know where to get any, if i do manage to test it i will leave a follow up here 👍 hope this gets fixed soon !!
title: YouTube bug
